versions.description: Player bounties for PvP servers. Players put currency on another player's head with `bounty <player> <amount>`; the amount is taken right away and held by the module. When the target is killed by another player, the killer collects the whole pot and the server hears about it. `bounties` lists the active bounties and `bountycancel <player>` refunds your own unclaimed bounty minus a cancel fee. Placers can never collect their own bounty, players in the same exclusion group cannot claim on each other, and bounties that nobody claims are refunded in full after a configurable number of days. Claims need the game to report who killed whom: a player-death event with an attacker (Rust, Minecraft and other connectors that send one) or a server log line such as 7 Days to Die's `GMSG: Player 'Victim' killed by 'Killer'` (pattern configurable). On games that report neither, no bounty is ever claimed and every bounty is refunded when it expires.

commands.name: bounty-place
commands.description: Put a currency bounty on another player
commands.helpText: Usage: bounty <player> <amount>. The amount is taken now and paid to whoever kills the player.

arguments.name: target
arguments.helpText: The player to put a bounty on

arguments.name: amount
arguments.helpText: How much currency to put on their head

commands.name: bounty-list
commands.helpText: Shows who has a bounty on them and how big the pot is.

commands.name: bounty-cancel
commands.description: Cancel your own bounty on a player
commands.helpText: Usage: bountycancel <player>. Refunds your unclaimed bounty minus the cancel fee.

arguments.name: target
arguments.helpText: The player whose bounty you placed

hooks.name: on-player-death
hooks.description: Pays the bounty when the game reports the killer as the attacker of a player-death event

hooks.name: on-kill-log
hooks.description: Pays the bounty when a server log line reports a PvP kill (default: 7 Days to Die's GMSG line)

cronJobs.name: expire-bounties
cronJobs.description: Refunds bounties older than the expiry setting to the players who placed them

functions.name: bounty-helpers

permissions.description: Allows a player to place bounties with the bounty command. The count is the maximum number of players they can have an active bounty on at the same time (0 or no count = no limit).
